ev.q: Based on the biography Fosse by Sam Wasson
the romantic and creative partnership between Bob Fosse and Gwen Verdon
Sam Rockwell and Michelle Williams give viewers plenty of razzle and dazzle
with Williams winning Outstanding Lead Actress
the groundbreaking musicals that allow Gwen to showcase her greatness
She is the greatest Broadway dancer of all time
The story of the entire series unfolds through back-and-forth flashes
with its eighth and final episode airing on May 28
